answer: Physical delivery escrow: an identity exists only once a courier hands a unique hardware token to a verified street address, and that handoff is recorded against the address. A single operator cannot occupy thousands of distinct physical locations at once, so each extra identity requires renting real space or paying a courier to reach it, costing roughly the delivery plus token fee per sybil. This forms an oasis of scarce geography no script can manufacture. It also gives honest users a haven from mass registration, though scaling courier routes remains a logistical fable for now.
